nodes.label: Irish-English Diglossia
nodes.evidence_status: Language estimates are reconstructed because the first census language question was in 1851; dialect, placename, and institutional dates are fact-checked.
nodes.rationale: Irish governed home, field, ritual, and oral culture while English governed law, commerce, documentation, and advancement, producing pervasive bilingual code-switching.

nodes.label: Language Choice as Social Signal
nodes.rationale: Irish can signal intimacy and local identity, English can signal authority or aspiration, and mixed speech is the historically natural default for many NPCs.
